readings.Aries: The person who doubted you is still in your head. Evict them. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Taurus: The thing you've been protecting might not need protecting anymore. Consider letting it breathe. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Gemini: Your wit is a gift. It's also where you go when you don't want to be known. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Cancer: Something is about to feel better. Not because anything changed — because the feeling has run its course. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Leo: There is a relationship where you've been the sun and the other person has been orbiting. Check the arrangement. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Virgo: There is a version of done that isn't perfect and is still correct. Accept it. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Libra: The position you hold in other people's lives is one of grace. Don't let it become one of function. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Scorpio: You have been in the dark long enough to know it. The light is coming and you will be ready. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Sagittarius: The person who challenged you was right. You don't have to tell them. Incorporate the data. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Capricorn: The version of yourself that needed to prove something — what were you proving, and to whom? There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Aquarius: You are more affected by the people around you than your detachment makes it appear. That's not a flaw. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Pisces: The feeling that's been following you is real. It belongs to you, not to the situation it attached to. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.

sky_notes: Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
Waxing crescent: we see a growing sliver of the Moon's sunlit half as it moves ~12° further east of the Sun each day.
Mars and Jupiter are within 0.5° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
